title: More People Are Using AI to Plan Trips
paragraphs: Artificial intelligence is quickly changing the way many people plan their trips. According to a new survey, the number of experienced travelers who use AI to plan international trips has grown quickly.

The survey was carried out by Global Rescue, a travel security company, between June 30 and July 6, 2026. It asked experienced international travelers about their use of AI. The results showed that 36% of them had used AI to plan international trips. In January 2026, the number was only 22%. This means the number grew by 64% in just six months.
At the same time, fewer travelers said they did not want to use AI. This number fell from 40% to 35%.

How do travelers use AI? The most common use was researching destinations, at 30%. Next came making travel plans, at 22%, and getting suggestions for flights and hotels, at 19%. Some travelers also used AI to check visa rules, plan transportation, find restaurants and translate languages.
Travelers outside the US were more likely to use AI. Almost 48% of them had used it, compared with 33% of travelers from the US.

Dan Richards, the head of Global Rescue, said, "Experienced travelers are becoming more comfortable with AI, but they're embracing it on their own terms." He also said that travelers still need human help when there are sudden problems, such as bad weather.
Other surveys have found similar trends. For example, a survey by Longwoods International found that 28% of American travelers had used AI to plan a trip in the past six months.
